title: Carrot: modeled ₹218/qtl left, Dhanotu (Mandi) → Bhuntar
summary: February 2025: reported carrot prices at Dhanotu (Mandi) and Bhuntar imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 100% of 24 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹218 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 648 same-variety market pairs screened for carrot in February 2025; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Bhuntar report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: February 2025
scenes.caption: Dhanotu (Mandi) (Himachal Pradesh) and Bhuntar (Himachal Pradesh) both reported carrot prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 24 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Dhanotu (Mandi) reported a median ₹900 per quintal. Bhuntar reported a median ₹1,250 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹350/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹350 per quintal, and Bhuntar was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 127 km by road
scenes.caption: 127 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~3 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹27/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹204 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹134 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Bhuntar report, the rule selects 21 of 24 modeled shipping days. 21 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹218 per quintal (₹146 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Carrot route from Dhanotu (Mandi) to Bhuntar was positive on 100% of matched days in February 2025. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹21,800, or ₹14,600 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to carrot
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹27/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Carrot route from Dhanotu (Mandi) to Bhuntar was positive on 100% of matched days in February 2025. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹21,800, or ₹14,600 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
